attributes.action: To hold a review of the education system to make it inclusive to all
attributes.additional_details: The education system was designed in 1870 and 1988 for factories and exams, not children.Now 22% of pupils are persistently absent and there were 913,000 suspensions last year.SEND pupils are hit hardest by isolation and public shaming.We ask for an independent review led by people who have lived it.SEND,SEMH,trauma,neurodiverse and neurotypical-plus teachers and parents,to find a way that works for everyone,keeps high standards,but includes regulation,reasonable adjustments and dignity.Benefits all, takes nothing away.
attributes.background: Commission an independent review of the education system co-produced with people with SEND, SEMH, trauma, neurodiverse and neurotypical lived experience, to find a way suitable for all pupils.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We understand you would like an independent review of the education system to consider how it could be made more inclusive for all pupils.

The Government has recently conducted independent reviews of the curriculum and assessment system and support for neurodivergent children and young people. It has also published proposals for reforms to make education more inclusive for children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND).

We're not sure how you would like the review you're proposing to be different from these reviews and the Government's existing proposals.

You can find out more here:

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/curriculum-and-assessment-review-final-report

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/neurodivergence-task-and-finish-group-report

https://www.gov.uk/government/consultations/send-reform-putting-children-and-young-people-first/send-reform-putting-children-and-young-people-first-html-version

You could start a new petition calling for specific changes to the Government's proposed reforms, or explaining clearly what additional review you would like the Government to carry out.
